blind.description: A stylized woven wicker/rattan barrel armchair featuring a high rounded backrest that curves smoothly into rounded armrests with rolled front caps, a cylindrical woven lower base, and a thick circular seat cushion upholstered in green and cream striped fabric.
blind.from_above: A rounded horseshoe-shaped wicker rim enclosing a circular green-and-cream vertically striped cushion, with two knobbed armrest fronts.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 45% as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2.5 to 2.7 feet tall) and about 2.5 feet wide across the armrests.

notes: proportions are roughly 1:1:1 cube rather than the narrower catalog estimate
